title: Upstream request rate
description: Our OUTBOUND request rate to SatNOGS / CelesTrak, so we can prove we stay a considerate consumer (the lesson of the SatNOGS IPv4 block). The other half of provider-refusal, which only shows when we get refused.

target.rawSql: SELECT started AS time, coalesce(ended, now()) AS timeend, coalesce(note, 'No answer from the ' || source || ' API: the control room ran on stale data' || CASE WHEN ended IS NULL THEN ' (ongoing)' ELSE '' END) AS text, 'upstream-cut' AS tags FROM provider_outage WHERE started <= $__timeTo() AND coalesce(ended, now()) >= $__timeFrom() ORDER BY started

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '5m') AS "time", source AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM upstream_request WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, source ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM upstream_request WHERE source = 'satnogs' AND ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM provider_refusal WHERE source = 'satnogs' AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours'

SELECT source AS "Upstream", count(*) AS "Requests", round(avg(ms)) AS "Avg ms", to_char(max(ts), 'HH24:MI') AS "Last" FROM upstream_request WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY source ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: SatNOGS requests per 5 min, by internal caller
panels.description: Who inside Overwatch asked the gateway (X-Overwatch-Caller: ingest, batch-<script>, ...). Internal attribution only: SatNOGS sees one identity. Rows before the column existed show as 'unknown'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '5m') AS "time", coalesce(caller, 'unknown') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM upstream_request WHERE source = 'satnogs' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(caller, 'unknown') AS "Caller", count(*) AS "Requests", round(avg(ms)) AS "Avg ms", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IS NULL OR status >= 400) AS "Failed", to_char(max(ts), 'HH24:MI') AS "Last" FROM upstream_request WHERE source = 'satnogs' AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
